description: Stable wire envelope for Arena protocol messages. Canonical form is canonical JSON (object keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace); the envelope digest is sha256 over the canonical serialization. idempotencyKey MUST be non-null when kind is "command" (architecture-lock rule 17: long-running jobs are idempotent and correlation-addressable).

correlationId.description: Correlation identifier for the causal flow this message belongs to.

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key; required (non-null) for command messages.

payload.description: Message payload, addressed by the schema ref.

schema.description: SchemaRef of the payload schema, in string form.

title: Arena Envelope v1
